# Third-party optics references and adaptations

## Eric Bruneton — black_hole_shader

Source: https://github.com/ebruneton/black_hole_shader
Pinned revision: e72b3f293409893a6fa25528b29572c96fc57f57
License: BSD-3-Clause, retained in vendor/bruneton/LICENSE and file headers.
Paper: Real-time High-Quality Rendering of Non-Rotating Black Holes (2020), https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.08735

Bundled original functions.cc and functions.glsl are reference material. vendor/bruneton/geodesic.js adapts the photon-orbit equation used by the precomputation. Our reduced game renderer generates a deflection lookup, then projects outgoing rays onto a finite background plane. This is an adaptation of the equations, not a claim to implement the complete Bruneton beam-tracing renderer.

## algometrix — blackhole-sim

Source: https://github.com/algometrix/blackhole-sim
Pinned revision: 0ee5541ec4ffcd9ca708f37c080bf00b7f3ef6d1
License: MIT, retained in vendor/algometrix/LICENSE.

Bundled original gravitationalWave.ts and grid.vert are references for outgoing quadrupolar phase and radial attenuation. vendor/algometrix/wave.js adapts this into causal plus/cross TT strain displacements for sampling the background image. Wave amplitudes and time scales are exaggerated for gameplay. This is a visual linearized approximation, not a solution of the dynamical Einstein equations.

## Original assets

All PNG textures in assets/ are generated by tools/generate-assets.mjs. They contain no downloaded astronomical photographs or other third-party imagery.
